label: Kodak Portra 800
source: Kodak Alaris technical data E-4040 (February 2016, revised 2-16), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (pages 4 and 5); Print Grain Index from page 3

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal exposure, erg/cm2, for density 0.2 above D-min)

print_grain_index.note: Kodak Print Grain Index (diffuse printing, 14 in viewing distance); RMS granularity not published

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Kodak Alaris / Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometry x = (log H - Log H Ref) / log10(2), Log H Ref -1.74 lux-seconds read from the characteristic-curve chart; density is Status M including base, made monotone by running maximum. Spectral sensitivity kept only where the curve is drawn above the chart floor (0.0); wavelengths where a curve leaves the chart are omitted, so a channel's wavelength list can be non-contiguous. Individual dye curves not published; dye_density holds only the published midscale neutral and minimum density curves. Characteristic curves (EI 800, page 4): Exposure Daylight, Densitometry Status M, Log H Ref -1.74 (no process line); this chart's log-exposure labels print -2.0 and -3.0 in swapped positions, the ticks are evenly spaced and the axis is calibrated -4.0 to 1.0 from the frame; chart artwork code printed as E40440E. The EI 1600 (Push 1) and EI 3200 (Push 2) characteristic curves (E4040S, E4040T) are not digitized. Spectral sensitivity (page 4): Daylight, effective exposure 1/200 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min. Spectral dye density (page 5): Process C-41, typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min; the midscale neutral curve is drawn dashed. Print Grain Index table as published (page 3), no print sizes in cm are published. The MTF chart (Exposure Daylight, Process C-41) is not digitized.

scan.note: fitted to 93 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871920252-kodak-portra-800/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
